dispatch: Only unmodified exact built-in AtmosphereCorrection.tropo with GPU backend, nonempty visible satellites and no ionosphere request is batched across that epoch. CPU fallback, subclasses, instance/class method replacement, custom callbacks, no-atmosphere and ionosphere paths keep original scalar order.
semantics: Same visible indices, FP64 LLA and elevations, same unchanged native atmosphere kernel per satellite. All geometry, models, candidates, channels, samples, Doppler, seeds and IQ arithmetic remain unchanged. No cross-call cache.
tradeoff: Use existing GPU batch API once instead of once per visible satellite; native allocations scale with the visible count for one call. No persistent cache or added workspace; no CUDA/source/PE change.
performance_gate: At least10% complete compute_epoch reduction with built-in GPU atmosphere and real IQ in ordinary12/32-satellite conditions,4/5 improving rounds, exact returned bits and no material no-atmosphere/custom/CPU/callback regression.

baseline_diagnostic_profile.method: Current exact build PE explicitly loaded; same owned normal-priority process pinned to last allowed CPU; warm full real CUDA-IQ compute_epoch with built-in GPU troposphere,12 visible satellites and seed37. All outputs checked outside profiling/timing. Twenty unprofiled calls and20 profiled calls per case; nonexclusive host.
baseline_diagnostic_profile.limits: cProfile exclusive/cumulative costs include native synchronization; inclusive costs overlap. Diagnostic only; not a baseline/candidate speedup. No ionosphere request in these cases.

confirmation.method: Own normal-priority process pinned to last allowed CPU; independent before/after Python modules, separate owners and identical native PEs. Serial alternating complete calls; every returned field and IQ byte checked outside timing; nonexclusive host.

limits: Applies only to standard unmodified GPU troposphere with no ionosphere request. No-atmosphere, CPU, subclass and custom callback paths keep scalar behavior.

Host/GPU nonexclusive. Initial3x10 controls include some6.8..7.9% regressions; all raw samples retained.5x30 confirmation keeps non-fast controls within3.7% regression and includes gains as well; no uniform control speedup claimed.
Profile costs are diagnostic and include profiling overhead/synchronization; inclusive costs overlap and are not summed into unprofiled wall time.
Retained scalar routes emit preexisting NumPy size-one-array conversion deprecations; raw logs retained. CUDA checker summaries are zero.
Benchmarks and tests explicitly load the current D211 build BVH because installed BVH PE remains in use at D208. This Python-only change requires no new native binary.
No new long real-data positioning-error distribution or whole PF/GNSS/IMU speedup; no speedup claimed for ordinary no-atmosphere epochs.
